title: StructuralHealth SensorVibrationPanel

stats.done_summary:
Successfully completed the Structural Health Monitoring Analysis for the rotating equipment fleet. 

**Deliverables Created:**
- `report/report.md` - Comprehensive quarterly reliability assessment report with executive summary, methodology, results, discussion, and recommendations
- `report/images/` - 7 publication-quality figures (PNG format):
  - fig1_vibration_timeseries.png - Time series for all 8 assets
  - fig2_zone_comparison.png - Zone-level vibration distributions
  - fig3_vib_temp_correlation.png - Vibration-temperature scatter plots
  - fig4_correlation_heatmap.png - Sensor correlation matrix
  - fig5_risk_ranking.png - Asset risk scores and priorities
  - fig6_trend_analysis.png - Degradation trends for priority assets
  - fig7_iso_distribution.png - ISO 10816 zone time distribution
- `code/analysis.py` - Complete analysis implementation
- `outputs/` - Statistical results including risk rankings, correlation matrices, and trend analysis

**Key Findings:**
- Critical asset CMP-201 (compressor) identified with Risk Score 75.0, operating in ISO Zone D (Danger) 86.5% of the time
- Strong vibration-temperature correlation (r=0.951) validates monitoring approach
- MOT-002 shows increasing degradation trend requiring proactive maintenance
- Zone_C compressors exhibit 13× higher vibration than other zones

**Analysis Scope:**
- 69,120 sensor observations across 8 assets in 4 zones
- 90-day observation window (Q1 2024) with 15-minute sampling
- ISO 10816-1 vibration severity classification
- Composite risk scoring with trend analysis
